away.summary: The Flames are coming off a 4-2 loss to the Ducks in their most recent meeting, where they showed improvement but fell short. They will be without forward Sam Honzek due to a lower-body injury, listed as week-to-week. Goaltender Dustin Wolf is confirmed to start, with Devin Cooley as the backup.

home.summary: The Ducks won the previous meeting 4-2, with Ryan Poehling scoring the game-winner before exiting due to injury. Poehling has since been placed on IR, and Cutter Gauthier is day-to-day. The Ducks recalled Roger McQueen from the AHL for potential debut. Goaltender Ville Husso is projected to start based on prior usage.
